[공연소개]\n\n지난 2023년 9월, 서울 세종문화회관 대극장에서 성.en:
[Concert Introduction]

This is the first paid solo recital in Seoul in three years by the "original popera star" Lim Hyung-joo (40, Chair Professor of Vocal Music at the Municipal Academy of Arts in Rome), following the grand "25th Anniversary Solo Recital <King Of Popera>" held at the Grand Theater of the Sejong Center for the Performing Arts in Seoul last September 2023!

Lim Hyung-joo, a true legend of popera produced by Korea—whose achievements include being the first Korean to receive the UN Peace Medal, conquering the three major halls of Carnegie Hall in the U.S. with solo performances, signing distribution contracts for his solo album with the world's four major record labels, winning awards from Japan's NHK 'Kohaku Uta Gassen' and both the Obama and Trump Presidential Awards, serving as a voter and judge for the U.S. Grammy Awards, having a private audience and performance with Pope Francis, being a Lifetime Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts and receiving the FRSA title from the British Royal Family, receiving the Presidential Commendation of the Republic of Korea, and being the youngest recipient of the Order of Merit for Korean People, the Camellia Medal—will hold a New Spring Solo Concert titled 'Popera Sensation (The Emotion of Popera)!' at the Youngsan Art Hall in Yeouido, Seoul, on March 20 at 7:30 PM. At this performance, Lim Hyung-joo is set to present the audience with the "essence of popera"—elegant yet splendid, lyrical yet grand—accompanied by the fantastic accompaniment of the Korean National Philharmonic Ensemble, where he has served as music director for a long time. The program will feature classical, pop, musical, and Korean ballads, as well as special 70s and 80s dance tracks.

It is certain that the public will pay close attention to his approachable side, having shed his mysterious image through recent appearances on EBS's *Seo Jang-hoon's Millionaire Neighbor*, KBS's *The Signature: 100 People's Emotion Show*, Channel A's *Table for Four*, and TV Chosun's *Dad and Me*, alongside his beautiful and heartwarming songs that have become even more intimate. [공연소개]\n\n재즈 음반 레코드 레이블로 대중적인 인기는 물론 예술적.en:
[Concert Introduction]

As a jazz record label, Blue Note holds immense symbolic significance for jazz enthusiasts, not only in terms of popular appeal but also in terms of artistic achievement. Paul Cornish, a rising pianist ambitiously recruited by Blue Note, is currently active in the band of American modern saxophone virtuoso Joshua Redman, and his debut album was released by Blue Note in 2025.

Numerous media outlets have praised his debut album, *You're Exaggerating!*, noting that Blue Note has once again demonstrated its discerning eye in discovering new artists with fresh ideas. The Financial Times evaluated the collaboration between Blue Note and Paul Cornish under the headline, "Blue Note strikes again." During an interview following his visit to Korea in 2025, Don Wirth, the head of Blue Note, referred to him as a "very profound next-generation musician" whom jazz listeners should pay new attention to.

From classical bebop reminiscent of bebop masters Bud Powell and Thelonious Monk to post-bop creative jazz continuing the lineage of modern pianists such as Jason Moran and Robert Glasper, Paul Cornish's solo piano concert will be a special performance where you can experience the essence of 21st-century modern jazz pianism through a lyrical yet powerful sound, adding his own unique colors to the great legacy of Blue Note.

A message of hope conveyed by two sister cities! A special performance will unfold to fill the stage with magnificent resonance at the threshold of winter.

Prepared to commemorate the sister city relationship between Gongju and Andong and to strengthen the friendship between the two cities, this concert will present Beethoven's final symphony, 'The 9th Symphony,' considered one of the greatest masterpieces in classical history.

Beethoven's spirit, which sang of humanity and hope even in desperate circumstances, blends with the meeting of two cities that have preserved a long history, conveying even deeper meaning.

The exquisite and powerful performance of the Gongju-Chungnam Symphony Orchestra, representing Gongju, will be combined with the delicate and rich harmonies of the Gongju City Choir and the Andong City Choir to create explosive synergy. The moment the 4th movement, 'Ode to Joy,' rings out, the stage and the audience will feel a heart-pounding thrill as they become one!

It will offer a deep resonance to your hearts with melodies of peace and harmony.

[Performance Introduction]

A Living Book: Don Quixote Unfolded as a Puppet Show

The puppet show *Sancho and Don Quixote* tells the story of Sancho, who embarks on an adventure with Don Quixote. It is a reimagined work featuring Sancho as a child and the protagonist; while it differs from the original novel, it faithfully captures the original message that "Tomorrow's Don Quixote is Sancho." The puppet show *Sancho and Don Quixote* was produced so that even children who cannot yet read can experience it as if it were a living, moving book.

In a strange and mysterious old bookstore, a different adventure awaits every time you open a book. The adventure awaiting today is the story of the knight Don Quixote.

An ordinary boy who enters the bookstore is called "Sancho" and, led by Don Quixote, sets out on a quest to become an honorable knight.

Events beyond imagination occur, such as fighting windmill giants and black-maned lions...

Just then, a huge dragon appears before his eyes! What will happen to Sancho and Don Quixote when they come face-to-face with a dragon they can neither avoid nor defeat?

[Synopsis]

Lead the way, Sancho! Take out your trumpet and blow it! Let's go, adventure!

My friend Sancho, tell me where to find the lion now!

[Performance Introduction]

*The Tale of Yi Saeng Gyu Jang* from *Geumo Sinhwa* by the Joseon Dynasty literati Kim Si-seup is an essential classic for the literature section of the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT).

This musical reinterprets *The Tale of Yi Saeng Gyu Jang* in a modern way, expressing the sentiments of traditional Korean music through contemporary sensibilities, creating a production that possesses both artistic and educational value.

[Synopsis]

Choi Rang, in the prime of her youth, full of curiosity and aspirations.

Having loved the unsparing love of her parents from a wealthy and happy home, she always tried her best to be a pretty daughter.

But when did it start? Was it because she laughed along with her friends over news of their relationships?

The sudden breeze of blossoming excitement in her heart feels awkward to her, but it is true that it is not a bad thing.

I want to love, too. Not the free love I have enjoyed until now, but the first love I can have as myself!

If only I could, I would pour out my love without regret. And I will protect that love forever and be happy for the rest of my life!

Life may be as hard as frozen ground, but I am always living as the me of today.

Yi Saeng, living for the happiness of today.

Yi-saeng, born into a poor family despite his high education. He lives to fulfill his father's unachieved dreams, but

"This is not the life I want. Yet, I cannot disappoint my parents' expectations. Why wouldn't I be interested in a woman? My family's primary goal is my success. To think of love before that is absurd. However, on this day when everything seems just right, I feel strangely uneasy."

When these two different people meet and feel they share a solid and perfect love, a trial arrives...

[Performance Introduction]

Who said classical music is boring? Beyond imagination! A comic string quartet that will keep you laughing uncontrollably!

Produced by the Spanish performance specialist YLLANA Production, the string quartet 'Paganini' is a unique comedic performance that breaks the mold of classical concerts, which are often perceived as merely serious and solemn.

It captivates the audience with witty humor and a beautiful medley of music that stimulates the emotions, while specifically reflecting the complex composition methods, reckless personality, and musical interpretations of the genius musician Paganini within the narrative. Presented by four outstanding musicians with elegant playing skills, this performance represents a new genre known as 'classical contemporary music,' receiving praise not only from general audiences but also from discerning, music-savvy audiences. It can be enjoyed by audiences worldwide regardless of age, gender, or nationality, and has been recognized for its artistic merit by winning awards at numerous international festivals, including the 'Best Production Award' at the 2008 Edinburgh Fringe Festival in the UK. Invited as the opening production of the Busan International Theatre Festival, it recorded a sell-out.

In 2026, it will create an experience where the audience can connect with the stage through laughter, featuring even more upgraded humor and irony.

`Class That Remains Unchanged Over Time, The Ultimate Performance for Your Parents`

Joo Hyun-mi, a living legend in the history of Korean popular music, will brilliantly grace the stage of the Gongju Arts Center. Exhibiting an unrivaled presence even amidst the glitz of K-POP, her voice embodies the very essence of the "Queen of Live Performances," possessing artistic value that transcends the ages.

Having passed her 40th anniversary since debut, Joo Hyun-mi plans to present not only national favorites such as "The Man from Sinsadong" and "Song of Sorrow," but also the essence of traditional Korean songs like "The Tavern Without an Address" and "Spring Days Are Gone," reinterpreted with a modern sensibility. This will be a special time that conveys poignant longing to the parents' generation and profound musical resonance to the children's generation. Re-gifting your parents the most radiant days of their lives on their most special day. This concert will be a choice for Parents' Day that is more dignified and meaningful than any other gift. [Performance Introduction]

Broadcaster Jo Hye-ryeon’s first directorial and starring role!

A tenacious mother in the market during the 1980s... the story of our own mothers!

The play *I Love You, Mom*, which has garnered attention for featuring broadcaster Jo Hye-ryeon as both director and lead actress, tells the story of 'Ok-hee' in the 1980s. Having lost her husband, she has lived a life of tenacity, selling fish in the market while looking only for her son.

The play depicts the journey of 'Cheol-dong,' a naive son who took his mother's endless sacrifice for granted, as he belatedly comes to realize her true love.

The stage is filled with delightful laughter and heart-wrenching emotion that remind us of the mothers of our days.

In May, the Month of the Family, this will be a warm time for the whole family to laugh and cry together while reflecting on the love of parents that we may have forgotten.

[Synopsis]

"Come on in, take a look, buy something~~"

A mother who has lived a strong life as a mother, not just a woman, running a fish business alone without a husband. To such a mother, there is always a blunt and immature son.

...One day, Mom receives a cancer diagnosis.

"Mom."

"Wow."

"I'm in pain... I feel like I'm going to die."

"It's okay... You'll be fine soon."

"Really?"

"Mom."

"Wow."

"Can I manage on my own?"

"Well... who are you to be... Mom isn't worried at all. You can do it."

"......."

"Cheol-dong... Mom is leaving..."

[Introduction]

A heartwarming true story about a grandfather who sets out to find his old love, separated by war, and his grandson who dreamed of writing a melodrama.

Emotion fills the space without flashy stage techniques—this is the power of a 'real' story!

The play *Me and My Grandfather* is based on the true story of Min Jun-ho, the representative and director of the theater company *Gongyeonbaedal Service Ganda*.

This play, which is completed by 'Jun-hee,' a playwright who wanted to write a magnificent melodrama, as she observes her maternal grandfather, portrays the simple and sincere landscapes of our lives without artificial direction.

It reminds us of the fact that "those we call Grandma and Grandpa were once young men who experienced passionate love,"

offering deep empathy and warm comfort that spans all generations.

[Synopsis]

'Jun-hee,' a playwright full of youthful vigor who wants to write a melodrama,

discovers true 'life' as he sets out to find his grandfather's old love.

Jun-hee is an energetic playwright who dreams of writing a wonderful melodrama.

His teacher instructs him to observe and complete his maternal grandmother and grandfather.

However, his grandmother suddenly collapses before he can even begin writing.

Eventually, Jun-hee begins observing only his grandfather,

recording his voice and listening to stories of his past.

He eventually sets out to find even his grandfather's acquaintance,

whom his grandmother had warned him "absolutely do not help with the search" before she collapsed.

As he listens to his grandfather's story, he gets the feeling that the person might be a woman! Could she be his grandfather's first love?

Driven by the hope that a melodrama might be completed, Jun-hee disobeys his grandmother's instructions and sets out to find Grandmother Im Su-im.

Will the interesting path Jun-hee wants to write lie ahead on that road?

[공연소개]\n‘깊은 음악성과 독보적인 존재감’으로 세계 무대의 주목을.en:
[Concert Introduction]

Cellist Kian Soltani, who has garnered attention on the global stage for his "profound musicality and unrivaled presence," and pianist Jaehong Pak, who has rapidly expanded his standing through international competitions, present a duo recital.

Soltani, a resident artist with the Iceland Symphony Orchestra, is a performer described by The Times as a "cellist to watch" and by Gramophone as "perfection itself." As a Deutsche Grammophon exclusive artist, he has collaborated with world-class orchestras such as the Berlin Staatskapelle, the Munich Philharmonic, and the NHK Symphony.

Jaehong Pak gained international renown by winning the 2021 Ferruccio Busoni International Piano Competition along with four special awards, and has proven his musical prowess through victories at the Cleveland International Young Artists Piano Competition and the Gina Bachauer Competition. On this stage, through a program spanning Reza Vali, Schubert, and Rachmaninov, they naturally reveal their respective musical roots and interpretations. Soltani’s cello, combining deep lyricism with exquisite technique, and Park Jae-hong’s piano, possessing a broad timbre and solid structural sense, form a dense ensemble through close collaboration. Completed by the convergence of experience accumulated on the international stage and mature musicality, this duo recital promises to offer the depth of authentic chamber music that transcends mere ostentation.

모나코 몬테카를로 발레단, 백조의 호수.en: Monaco Monte Carlo Ballet, Swan Lake

[공연소개]\n동화적 환상을 걷어낸 흑백의 스릴러\n\n고전 발레의 우아.en:
[Performance Introduction]

A Black-and-White Thriller Stripped of Fairytale Fantasy

The Monaco Monte Carlo Ballet, which has captivated dance fans worldwide by exquisitely combining the elegance of classical ballet with the unconventionality of contemporary dance, enchants Korean audiences with Jean-Christophe Maillot's masterpiece, *Swan Lake*. Maillot strips away the fairytale fantasy of the original work and transforms the "Swan" into an intricate psychological drama that delves into the human psyche, unfolding the contrasts of black and white, good and evil, and purity and desire through sophisticated mise-en-scène. The music, newly composed based on Tchaikovsky's original score, will be performed live by the Korea Coop Orchestra, further enriching the tension and emotional depth of the production.

[공연소개]\n\n\n재즈 음반 레코드 레이블로 대중적인 인기는 물론 예.en:
[Concert Introduction]

As a jazz record label, Blue Note holds immense symbolic significance for jazz enthusiasts, not only for its popular appeal but also for its artistic achievements. Paul Cornish, a rising pianist ambitiously recruited by Blue Note, is currently active in the band of American modern saxophone virtuoso Joshua Redman, and his debut album was released by Blue Note in 2025.

Numerous media outlets have praised his debut album, *You're Exaggerating!*, as demonstrating that Blue Note once again possesses a keen eye for discovering new artists with fresh ideas. The Financial Times evaluated the combination of Blue Note and Paul Cornish under the headline, "Blue Note strikes again." This first performance in Korea, featuring the original members who participated in the album, is composed of a trio consisting of Joshua Crumbley (bass) and Jonathan Pinson (drums), offering the opportunity to experience firsthand the vibrant performance and energy of these young musicians who represent the current American jazz scene.

**Concert Introduction** From classical bebop reminiscent of bebop masters Bud Powell and Thelonious Munch to post-bop creative jazz continuing the lineage of modern pianists such as Jason Moran and Robert Glasper, the Paul Cornish Trio's first performance in Korea adds his own unique colors to the great legacy of Blue Note. Through a performance featuring a lyrical yet powerful sound, this concert promises to be an opportunity to experience the essence of 21st-century jazz pianism.

[About Paul Cornish]

Having been a finalist at the 2023 American Piano Awards and the Herbie Hancock International Jazz Piano Competition, where he won third place, he has been recognized for his youthful sensibility and impeccable skill, engaging in extensive session work with artists such as Joshua Redman, Louis Cole, and Mark Guiliana. Turning 29 this year, he already displays the maturity of a master as well as the agility and creativity required for jazz interplay, making him a talented pianist discovered by Blue Note.

서울시향 김선욱과 알리스 사라 오트 ②.en: Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra's Sunwook Kim and Alice Sara Ott ②

[공연소개]\n독주자로 서울시향과 각별한 관계를 맺어왔고 지휘자로는 지난.en:
[Concert Introduction]

Sunwook Kim, who has maintained a special relationship with the Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra as a soloist and made his debut as a conductor at the regular concert in December 2022, meets the orchestra once again. The concert opens with Modest Mussorgsky’s *Night on Bald Mountain*, which leaves a memorable atmosphere with its rough-textured melodies, followed by Maurice Ravel’s Piano Concerto in G Major. Alice Sara Ott, who made a name for herself as a child prodigy in Germany early on and has firmly established herself on the international stage with a popular trajectory, participates as the soloist for this concerto, which is radiant in every moment. Conductor Sunwook Kim, who curated the second half with works by Richard Strauss during the October 2023 concert with the Seoul Philharmonic, has prepared Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2 for this performance. We look forward to the Brahms that musician Sunwook Kim will present with the Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra, having been acclaimed as an outstanding Brahms interpreter throughout his career as a pianist and demonstrating a special affection for the composer even after beginning his career as a conductor.

[공연소개]\n\n\n\n미씽 Missing\n\n현대무용 × 인터랙티브.en:
[Performance Introduction]

Missing

Contemporary Dance × Interactive Media Art

A Record of Adaptation, an Unceasing Body

In a lost world, what record will your body leave behind?

What has disappeared?

Nature, air, or senses?

Or is it the human form we knew?

<Missing> observes the human body reorganizing itself within a changed environment. In this work, the body is not a subject that expresses emotions. The body is a structure that responds to the environment and a system that constantly adapts.

What "Missing" refers to is not a simple disappearance. It signifies the loss of familiar senses, previous breathing patterns, the relationship with nature, and a state in which parts of the form that defined humanity have been erased. However, this work does not mourn that loss. It quietly observes the body that continues to transform and adapt even after it has vanished.

[Synopsis]

A body wrapped in plastic wrap sits on the stage. It is not a sign of oppression, but a condition. In an environment filled with dust and toxins, the body wraps itself and redesigns its functions within limited conditions. As media art overlaps the body, the physical form is distorted, transformed, and reborn.

The body faces the floor. Contact with the earth—nature that ultimately remains amidst the artifacts. A body that awakens again at the cellular level, through the skin and through movement. The dancers' movements unfold across the space in the form of waves and contour lines, responding in real-time with interactive media.

When the environment changes, the body changes too. In the place where standards of beauty have vanished, the body creates a new balance. Physically impossible bodily distortions are visualized through media, and traces of evolution are revealed on the stage in unfamiliar forms.

Nevertheless, humans do not give up on relationships. Pushing and pulling, misaligned and intertwined, the transformed bodies adapt together. The essence of relationships remains the same, even as the environment changes.

A song flows. The body responds to the sound. In a place where language cannot reach, the body instinctively moves toward nature. A body that is distorted and changed, yet does not give up hope. *Missing* is not a work that restores what has disappeared. It is an exploration of the body that continues to transform and adapt, living on even after vanishing. If, after this piece ends, the audience becomes conscious of their breathing and body for a moment, that is enough.

툇마루무용단 정기공연: Community [대학로].en: Toetmaru Dance Company Regular Performance: Community [Daehak-ro]

[공연소개]\n\n1. <NODE>\n심재호 안무의 〈NODE〉는 인간이.en:
[Performance Introduction]

1. <NODE>

Choreographed by Shim Jae-ho, <NODE> explores the structure of the "group" that humans have formed for survival, and the mechanism of "division" that inevitably arises within it. We form groups to connect with one another, but as the group expands, differences in standards become boundaries, creating new separations. Within the structure of human society, which becomes more finely divided the more broadly connected it becomes, the individual begins to be defined by "where they belong."

Rather than asserting this structure, the work poses the question of whether a society that is complete as a single entity is possible. Here, "node" signifies a state where each individual exists as a single point rather than as a massive whole; the piece seeks to explore, through the body, relationships that coexist in an invisible tension, neither completely merged nor severed.

2. <Walk and Waltz>

Everyone walks. But how much do we truly gaze at the life hidden within those steps? Choreographed by Kim Young-woong, *Walk and Waltz* is an experimental creation themed "floating in the rhythm of life," taking "walking," the most mundane human act, as the starting point of the dance. Through the everyday act of walking, this work seeks to capture the inner voices and life experiences that humans encounter while living. The dancer's steps extend beyond simple movement to expand into a flow of emotions, and traces of daily life are reconstructed into visual movements. The stage, utilizing light, sound, and the textures of costumes, sensuously reveals the theme of "a body walking through time."

[Introduction]

Between Morality and Survival: The Price of Choices Women Had to Bear

We present *Mrs. Warren's Profession* by George Bernard Shaw, a Nobel Prize winner in Literature and a leading British critic, thinker, and playwright. This work caused a sensation upon its release by sharply criticizing the structural inequality in British society that economically oppresses women through the "prostitute issue." It also draws attention for the fact that five-time Olivier Award winner Imelda Staunton plays the mother-daughter role alongside her own daughter, Bessie Carter, for the first time. Furthermore, this production is a new collaboration between Imelda Staunton and director Dominic Cooke, deeply illuminating human choice and responsibility at the point where morality and independence, and tradition and progress, collide.

[Synopsis]

Bibi Warren is a young woman of intellect and independence who has just graduated from college. She discovers that her mother, Kitty Warren, had built her wealth in the past through socially unacceptable means to make a living. Bibi questions whether her mother's choice was morally justified, while grappling with the reality that it is not a thing of the past. The values ​​of the daughter, who seeks to live according to her convictions, clash with those of the mother, who had to survive in a patriarchal society. But what was the true price of the immense wealth Mrs. Warren amassed?

Muji the puppy follows a rabbit and accidentally falls into a strange land of colors.

There, Muji embarks on a special adventure to find the missing colors one by one. Along the journey, he meets the Color Queen and unique friends, learning the meaning and beauty of various colors such as red, yellow, and blue. As he finds more colors, Muji grows, and at the moment when all the colors come together to form a rainbow,

Based on Alice in Wonderland, *Muji in the Land of Strange Colors* is a performance where children can naturally learn about and discover colors as they follow the story, eventually creating their own colors.

The best gift for your child! A 'Happy Day' with the musical <Alsa-tang>

On Children's Day, May 5th, the Gongju Arts Center transforms into a giant dream playground for children.

The Arts Center's special Children's Day project, which began in 2025, welcomes family audiences this year with even more upgraded fun and emotion.

The family musical <Alsa-tang>, based on the bestselling novel by author Baek Hee-na, loved worldwide, will take the stage at the Grand Theater. Through the story of Dongdong, who eats a mysterious candy and learns to hear the voice of his heart, the musical conveys the clumsy yet sincere love and courage of a family, promising to deliver a heartwarming sensation to both children and parents. The emotion continues beyond the stage. A variety of side events titled <Happy Day> will unfold in the lobby and outdoors before and after the performance.

Charming 'Small Theater,' exciting 'Outdoor Performances,' and a captivating 'Magic Show' will liven up the festive atmosphere. In addition, there is never a dull moment with plenty of hands-on activities, such as the welcoming "Daddy-Long-Legs" for the children. We hope this becomes the best Children's Day outing destination where the whole family can laugh, enjoy themselves, and create precious memories.

[Synopsis]

A story of warm comfort and growth delivered by the "Magic Hard Candy," which can hear the voice of the heart.

Based on the picture book *Hard Candy* by world-renowned author Baek Hee-na, the production faithfully recreates the touching emotions of the book through a solid storyline combined with beautiful music and various stage effects.

Since its premiere in 2019, it has ranked first in sales for three consecutive years (in the Nol Ticket Children and Family categories), making it a premium family musical that has captivated the hearts of not only children but also parents.

[Synopsis]

"That is hard candy. It's very sweet."

A bag of hard candy bought at a stationery store. As soon as a piece of candy is put in the mouth,

sounds that were originally unheard begin to be heard!

"Dongdong~ Dongdong~"

The voice of the heart told by the magic candy!

Whose voice will be heard next?

A Time Expanding from Listening to Understanding

The Lecture Concert is a lecture-style concert that explores diverse music genres—ranging from Baroque and Romantic classical music to opera, musicals, Latin classical (Tango), and jazz—through expert commentary and live performances.

It explains the birth, background, history, and representative works of composers in an easy and entertaining way. By focusing on popular pieces, it offers a multi-dimensional experience that can be enjoyed by everyone from beginners to enthusiasts of each genre. The performance is structured so that four independent acts are organically connected to help the audience understand the vast world of music as if naturally traveling through it, and to allow the audience to feel closer to music in their daily lives. We aim to present the audience with a special morning through coffee and cookies provided before the show, along with fun and interesting commentary and performances.

[Synopsis]

Park Dae-chul died after struggling in poverty his entire life due to a lack of money.

[Performance Introduction]

When the rhythm rings out, the stage becomes a festival.

Presented by the National Gugak Center’s Creative Orchestra, the orchestral performance <Festival> is a stage that reinterprets the deep breath of tradition with a modern sensibility, breaking down the boundaries of Korean traditional orchestral music and unfolding the essence of our dynamic music. Amidst the resonance of the majestic orchestra, the delicate melodies of the daegeum, piri, and haegeum come to life. From Yang Bang-eon’s "Frontier," familiar from broadcasts, to the deep resonance of Seodo Sori, the dazzling virtuosity of the mysterious saenghwang, and the tragic beauty of "Beompi Jungryu" from *Simcheongga*, the performance dramatically portrays the process of the sentiment of *han* (deep sorrow) soaring powerfully into the energy of *shinmyung* (exhilaration). The wave-like sound created by the overlapping of different breaths clearly reveals the essence of Korean music, and in particular, the "Pan-noleum" at the climax of the performance, where Samulnori and orchestral music blend together, will deliver an overwhelming sense of excitement that unites the stage and the audience. By incorporating popular trends and diverse compositions to boldly shatter the stereotype that "tradition is boring," this will become an exhilarating festival where even audiences unfamiliar with Korean traditional music are captivated by its dynamic energy, fully savoring the spirit of our sounds with their whole bodies.

해설이 있는 발레, 백조의 호수 [공주].en: Ballet with commentary, Swan Lake [The Princess]

[공연소개]\n\n귀로 듣고 눈으로 즐기는 친절한 발레 <백조의 호수>\.en:
[Performance Introduction]

A Friendly Ballet to Listen to and Enjoy with Your Eyes: *Swan Lake*

Presented by the Seoul City Ballet, *Swan Lake* is a "tailored to your level" performance designed to break the stereotype that ballet is difficult by combining the dancers' beautiful movements with friendly commentary, allowing people of all ages to enjoy it easily and entertainingly. The story begins with Prince Siegfried meeting Princess Odette, the Swan Queen cursed by the sorcerer Rothbart, at a lake in the forest and pledging their fated love. Although the sorcerer attempts to separate the two by introducing the Black Swan Odile, the story depicts a beautiful conclusion where they overcome trials through the power of true love and regain their happiness. Without needing to struggle to understand mime or the plot, simply following the narrator's exciting story will allow you to become deeply immersed in the work before you know it. For children encountering ballet for the first time, it becomes a living fairy tale, and for adult audiences, it serves as the ultimate introductory performance to easily savor the depth of classical music. [Synopsis]

Prologue: The Prince's Coming-of-Age Ceremony

After holding a grand coming-of-age ceremony and receiving a bow as a gift, Prince Siegfried sees a swan flying by and goes hunting by the lake with his friends.

Act 1: Scene at the Lakeside

Prince Siegfried, having followed the swan into the forest, is attacked by wolves and Rothbart by the lakeside, but overcomes the attack with the help of the swans.

He discovers Princess Odette, who is transforming into a human, falls in love at first sight, and proposes to her.

Hearing that the princess must receive the eternal love of one person to be freed from the devil's spell, Prince Siegfried pledges his vow of love.

Act 2: The Palace Ballroom

Prince Siegfried greets guests while waiting for Princess Odette to arrive.

While his friends and a ladybug are enjoying a party together,

the devil Rothbart appears with his daughter Odile, who resembles Princess Odette. Prince Siegfried, mistaking Odile—brought by the devil Rothbart—for Princess Odette, announces his marriage to her and, at Rothbart's request, promises eternal love. At this moment, the devil Rothbart reveals his true nature, and as Odile disappears, Prince Siegfried, overcome with grief, runs into the forest.

Act 3: Eternal Love
Princess Odette, condemned to live forever as a swan due to Prince Siegfried's betrayal. Prince Siegfried, who has come seeking forgiveness, and Princess Odette mourn their fate together, but they defeat the devil Rothbart through the power of love and promise eternal love.

[Synopsis]

"One day you cast a light upon me. From that day on, I have lived in great love."

Violetta, who lives a life of enjoying parties every night, receives a sincere declaration of love from Alfredo. She leaves her luxurious life in Paris behind and starts a new life with him. A one-time performance commemorating the 10th anniversary of his activities in Korea!

Violinist Danny Koo, loved by the entire nation for his "positive energy" on MBC's *I Live Alone*!

Having been active as the "busiest classical star" since his Korean debut in 2016, he is holding a recital to celebrate the year 2026, marking the 10th anniversary of his activities in Korea.

This performance is a meaningful stage that looks back on the journey of the past 10 years and signals the "beginning of a new journey" to move forward.

Opening spectacularly with Corelli's *La Folia*, a piece he cherishes, the program features a modern reinterpretation of a masterpiece by the classical maestro Bach,

He wishes to share the musical footprints of the past 10 years and the new beginning ahead with the audience.

A dreamlike time unfolding beyond a mysterious door,

The non-verbal performance <SNAP> is an original art performance depicting the journey of three mischievous 'tricksters' as they travel into a fantastic world through a mysterious door they accidentally discovered. Conveying the story solely through gestures and facial expressions without dialogue, this stage exquisitely combines media art, shadowgraphy, and mime with magic, offering a visual delight akin to watching a moving masterpiece. With no language barriers, everyone from illiterate children to adults can fully enjoy the intuitive humor and wit. The commotion of the extraordinary characters and the magical staging unfolding in the world beyond the door constantly stimulate the audience's dormant curiosity. This performance will be the most magical gift for the whole family to immerse themselves in, laugh, and enjoy together.

[공연소개]\n\n살아 움직이는 책, 인형극으로 펼쳐보는 돈키호테\n인형.en:
[Performance Introduction]

A Living, Moving Book: Don Quixote Unfolded as a Puppet Show

The puppet show *Sancho and Don Quixote* has been reimagined to allow even young children who cannot yet read to easily and enjoyably encounter the message of the book *Don Quixote*.

The story begins with Sancho, a nine-year-old boy, opening a "book" that leads him into a world of adventure. The staging, utilizing various types of puppets—such as jointed, board, and shadow puppets—along with pop-up books, portrays Don Quixote's absurd adventures on stage with even greater persuasiveness. Along with the actors' comical performances, music, including medieval-style dance tunes, adds romance to the artistic imagination.

[Synopsis]

The Story of Sancho Embarking on an Adventure with Don Quixote

Whenever you open a book in a strange and mysterious old bookstore, a different adventure awaits.

The adventure awaiting today is the story of the knight Don Quixote. An ordinary boy who enters the bookstore is called "Sancho" and, led by Don Quixote, sets out on a quest to become an honorable knight. As Sancho sets out on his journey with Don Quixote, unimaginable events occur at every turn, such as the appearance of windmill giants and black-maned lions… Just then, a massive dragon appears before their eyes! Faced with a dragon they can neither defeat nor avoid, what will happen to Sancho and Don Quixote?

[공연소개]\n천재 작곡가 모차르트가 생애 마지막으로 남긴 오페라 <마술.en:
[Performance Introduction]

The Magic Flute, the final opera left behind by the genius composer Mozart, will be performed on the stage of the Korea National Opera, representing Korea. This work, which depicts the journey of a man and a woman overcoming trials to find love amidst the conflict between reason and emotion symbolized by night and day, has been loved by people all over the world for over 200 years since its premiere in 1791. In addition to fantastic melodies including the "Queen of the Night" aria, the performance is structured to allow anyone to easily and enjoyably immerse themselves in the story, featuring Korean subtitles for the arias and dialogue in Korean. We hope the whole family will come together to savor this magical musical feast presented by Mozart.

[Synopsis]

This is a Singschwill (a German opera with dialogue interspersed like a play) completed by Mozart two months before his death.

By adding Mozart's beautiful music and comedic elements to a simple story of lovers and a battle between good and evil, this work remains beloved to this day, approximately 200 years after its premiere in 1791. In a world where the 'forces of light' ruled by Sarastro and the 'forces of darkness' ruled by the Queen of the Night are in conflict, Tamino, pursued by a giant snake, loses consciousness and is rescued by the Queen of the Night's three handmaidens. The Queen of the Night shows Tamino a portrait of her daughter, Pamina, and asks him to save her. The three handmaidens present a magic flute to Tamino, who has fallen in love with Pamina's portrait, and he sets off with Papageno to rescue Pamina, who has been captured by Sarastro. After many twists and turns, Tamino meets Pamina, and they confirm their love for each other and undergo Sarastro's trials to achieve their love.

[Performance Introduction]

Humorous choreography and a stage and visuals that look as if they were transported straight out of a fairy tale!

A “fairy tale painted with dance” featuring fun storytelling that resonates with children and dance.

“If you lie, your nose grows longer!”

Grandfather, who wanted to give Pinocchio a warm heart, and Pinocchio, who only causes trouble.

As time passes, Pinocchio, who used to cause all kinds of trouble and accidents, begins to feel the warmth of human hearts and love, eventually becoming a real child. Experience the happiness that comes from living a life of truth!

[Program]

Prologue - Pinocchio, the Tree Child

The fairy who granted a father's wish for a child: “If you prove that you are brave, truthful, and not selfish, you will become a real person someday!”

Chapter 1: The Village Market

In the peaceful market, a greedy count oppresses the villagers.

Chapter 2: Grandfather Returns Home

Pinocchio and his grandfather's first meeting.

Chapter 3: The Road to School

Pinocchio, different from ordinary children.

Chapter 4: Pinocchio's Lies

Pinocchio bravely jumps into a traveling troupe... His nose grows longer every time he lies, but returns to normal with just one word of 'truth'!

Chapter 5: Pinocchio's Wrong Choice

Pinocchio, who didn't listen to his father: "You must learn to choose between right and wrong. Your 'heart' will give you the answer."

Chapter 6: Inside the Whale's Belly...

Pinocchio learns of his father's love. He cries with worry and sadness for his father, who is trapped inside the whale's belly.

Epilogue - Pinocchio, a True Person Found Through His 'Heart'

A magical thing happened to Pinocchio after he found his 'true heart'!!!

Children's Day Special Performance Announcement

A special day at Centum Art Hall, filled with the laughter of children

A musical journey to meet animal friends, hand in hand with your child

Prepared by Centum Art Hall for Children's Day

The masterpiece ART Kids Concert <Animal Story>

As the march of the lions rings out, fish in the aquarium dance, and the beautiful melody of the swans flows,

children imagine, laugh, and move together within the music.

Dancing to Disney music, singing nursery rhymes together and doing rhythmic movements,

but a time to create memories with your child.

On Children's Day,

give your child the gift of a day to be remembered through music.

Experience the moment of tango, where red passion and deep resonance coexist,

at E&I Art Hall,

through the live performance of Buenos Tango Club.

경기도 용인시 처인구 원삼면 농촌파크로 126.en: 126 Nongchon Park-ro, Wonsam-myeon, Cheoin-gu, Yongin-si, Gyeonggi-do

왕과 사는 남자.en: The Man Living with the King

계유정난이 조선을 뒤흔들고 어린 왕 이홍위는 왕위에서 쫓겨나 유배길에 오.en: The Coup of Gyeyu shakes Joseon to its core, and the young King Yi Hong-wi is dethroned and sent into exile. Meanwhile, Eom Heung-do, the village head of Gwangcheongol in the remote mountains of Yeongwol, Gangwon Province, strives to establish Cheongnyeongpo as a place of banishment to help his struggling villagers. However, the person the village head welcomed with high hopes turned out to be the deposed King Yi Hong-wi. As the guardian of the place of exile who must monitor his every move, the village head finds himself increasingly troubled by Yi Hong-wi, who has lost his will to live…

오랜 연구 끝에 개발한 ‘호핑’ 기술로 동물 세계에 가까이 갈 수 있음을.en: Mabel, the protagonist, discovers that she can approach the animal world using "Hopping" technology developed after years of research. Amazed that it feels like "Avatar," she transforms into a robot beaver and infiltrates the animal world. As she learns to understand their language and experiences the animal world as if she were a real animal, she stops a bear from attacking another beaver in a pond, only to realize that they have their own order and rules. The doctor who developed the technology warns that it must not be used to disrupt the natural order, but Mabel cuts off communication, foreshadowing an unpredictable adventure to come.

일제강점기, 집단 자살 사건 이후 흔적 없이 사라진 사이비 종교 ‘삼선도.en: During the Japanese colonial period, ‘Samseondo’ was a cult that vanished without a trace following a mass suicide incident. Chae So-yeon (Jo Yoon-seo), a PD for an investigative social program, receives a tip from Matsuda, a reporter for Nagoya TV in Japan, regarding this religion that disappeared leaving behind only a ‘blood prophecy.’ The tip reveals that ‘Samseondo’ is still alive in a remote village, and that shamans are conducting a sealing ritual to prevent the prophecy from coming true. Upon arriving at the village, the reporting team realizes that the ‘blood prophecy’ has already begun there…

비밀도, 진실도 차가운 얼음 바다에 수장되는 블라디보스토크에서 서로 다른.en: A story of clashes between people with different objectives in Vladivostok, where secrets and truths are buried in the cold, icy sea.

베넷 가의 다섯 자매 중 둘째인 엘리자베스는 사랑하는 사람과의 결혼을 믿.en: Elizabeth, the second of the five Bennet sisters, is a proud and clever girl who believes in marrying the man she loves. Bingley, a gentleman from a wealthy and prestigious family, and his friend Darcy stay at the grand estate for the summer. Elizabeth and Darcy, who meet for the first time at a dance party, cannot take their eyes off each other. Darcy becomes increasingly captivated by her beauty and intelligence, and on a stormy hill during a torrential downpour, he confesses the passionate love he has kept deep in his heart to her. However, when she learns that Darcy opposed Jane's marriage to Bingley because Jane was not from a prestigious family, she turns away from him, considering him an arrogant, prejudiced snob...

24시간 빈틈없이 살아온 구청의 갓생 과장 국희. 승진은 코앞이고, 딸의.en: Kuk-hee, a section chief at the district office living a flawless life 24/7. A promotion is just around the corner, and even her daughter has found a job! She thought everything would proceed perfectly according to her plan. But then, her perfect steps start to go awry! A stolen promotion, a daughter out of contact, and an empty heart... To fix the chaotic rhythm of her life, she heads to a flamenco studio? A project to reclaim life's rhythm—it's okay not to be perfect!

자연 속에서 자유롭게 살아온 ‘아녜스’는 마을에 새로 온 교사 ‘윌리엄.en: Agnes, who has lived freely in nature, falls in love with William Shakespeare, a new teacher in the village, and they start a family. One day, an unexpected tragedy strikes the couple, and amidst the horrific pain of losing the most precious things in life, they overcome their wounds and tragedy in their own ways…

가족을 버리고 떠난 영화감독 구스타프는 재회한 딸에게 영화 출연을 제안한.en: Gustav, the film director who abandoned his family, offers his reunited daughter a role in his film. However, Nora flatly refuses, filled with distrust and resentment toward her father.

도심 속 동물 평화를 수호하는 정의의 너구리 ‘팔콘’! 배고픈 동물 친구.en: Falcon, the raccoon of justice guarding animal peace in the city! The moment he boards a train to help his hungry animal friends, the train, carrying only pets, begins to run wild without brakes, provoked by Hans, a badger burning with vengeance. Only minutes remain until a head-on collision! In this imminent crisis, Falcon joins forces with his newly met friends to embark on a thrilling escape operation for survival…

네가 마지막으로 남긴 노래.en: The last song you left behind

유난히 눈에 띄지 않는 소년 ‘하루토’와 유난히 빛나는 소녀 ‘아야네’..en: Haruto, a boy who stands out unusually, and Ayane, a girl who shines exceptionally brightly. The boy writes poems on behalf of the girl, who struggles to read and write, and those poems become songs that resonate throughout the world through her voice. A secret just for the two of them, a language unique to them. The moment music touches them before words, the most brilliant youth romance begins with the heart-fluttering excitement!

스탈린 시기의 소련, 자신이 하는 일에 갈등을 느끼는 한 젊은 검사의 이.en: The story of a young prosecutor in the Soviet Union during the Stalin era who feels conflicted about his work. An adaptation of a novella by Georgy Demidov.

전자음악의 선구자이자 영화음악 거장, 환경과 평화를 외치는 운동가로 활약.en: Ryuichi Sakamoto, an all-encompassing artist who has been active as a pioneer of electronic music, a master of film scores, and an activist advocating for the environment and peace. In December 2020, upon learning that he did not have much time left, he began to document his daily life. Every moment of Ryuichi Sakamoto, who lived on through music until the very end.

주먹 하나로 학교를 평정한 여고생, 이번엔‘추리닝’입고 돌아왔다! 강한.en: The high school girl who conquered the school with a single fist is back, this time wearing a tracksuit! Min-a, possessing a strong sense of justice and resilience, is an overly righteous girl who grew up with her aunt after losing her parents in an accident when she was young. Having entered high school with a promise never to fight again, Min-a dreams of a normal fresh start, but on her very first day, she falls for her classmate, Min-ki, who is handsome and appears unnecessarily righteous. The problem is Se-hyuk, the leader of a delinquent gang targeting Min-ki. Upon witnessing Se-hyuk's gang bullying Min-ki, Min-a can't stand it anymore and rescues him while wearing a tracksuit that covers his face. From that day on, the school is in an uproar trying to find the identity of the man in the tracksuit, and Min-ki embarks on a full-scale investigation (?) to find his savior. Meanwhile, a love triangle between Mina, Hyeri, and Sehyuk over Mingi heats up, and Mina ends up leading a triple life—pretending to be ordinary, a villain, and someone in love—while hiding her true identity. However, is that really possible for Mina, whose sense of justice is on the verge of exploding and whose temper is hot-tempered? Love gets tangled, her identity is on the verge of being exposed, and the fight grows bigger…

브루클린의 배관공에서 세계를 구한 히어로로 레벨업한 형제 ‘마리오’와 ‘.en: Brothers Mario and Luigi, who leveled up from Brooklyn plumbers into world-saving heroes, forge a special friendship after rescuing a lost Yoshi while on a mission in the Sand Kingdom. Meanwhile, to restore the fallen honor of the Bowser family, the evil prince Bowser Jr. kidnaps Rosalina, the guardian of the galaxy and mother of the Chicos, and attacks the Mushroom Kingdom to rescue his father, Bowser, who has been captured. Amidst this renewed crisis, Mario, Luigi, Peach, Toad, and the newly joined Yoshi venture into the vast galaxy to rescue Rosalina and stop Bowser Jr.'s extraordinary plan…

킬 빌: 더 홀 블러디 어페어.en: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair

23년 만에 공개되는 완전판, 275분 동안 펼쳐지는 완벽한 복수의 향연.en: The complete edition released after 23 years, a perfect feast of revenge unfolding over 275 minutes! Kiddo, once the greatest assassin, endures a horrific bloody wedding at the hands of Bill and his organization, the Deadly Vipers. Four years later, all that remains for her is merciless revenge. Kill Bill!

기이한 소문이 끊이지 않는 저수지 살목지의 로드뷰 화면에 촬영한 적 없는.en: An unidentified figure that has never been captured on camera is spotted on the Street View screen of Salmokji Reservoir, a place plagued by persistent strange rumors. Facing a situation where reshooting must be completed within the day, PD Su-in and the film crew head to Salmokji. As filming begins, senior colleague Gyo-sik, whose whereabouts had been unknown, appears, and as unexplained events unfold one after another, the film crew descends into utter chaos. Amidst the swirling terror, Gi-tae runs toward Su-in, but the more they try to escape, the deeper they are dragged into the abyss…

101번 국도를 따라 흔적도 없이 사라지는 보석들. 전설적인 절도범 ‘데.en: Jewels vanish without a trace along Route 101. Legendary thief Davis designs a perfect crime under his own set of rules. While everyone else is thrown into chaos, only Detective Lou, a man of principle and tenacity, spots the culprit and tightens the net. Targeting a massive insurance payout, Davis proposes a dangerous deal to insurance broker Sharon, and the flawless plan and sophisticated investigation spiral into an unexpected turn of events…

독일 대학의 한 식물원에는 1832년부터 인간을 바라보며 뿌리내린 장엄한.en: In a botanical garden at a German university stands a majestic ginkgo tree that has taken root, gazing at humans since 1832. The university's first female student in 1908. A young man cultivating both plants and love in 1972. A solitary neuroscientist in 2020. Over a century, this ginkgo tree quietly extends its branches into the lives of these three people, beginning to connect as one.

은하계를 누비는 현상금 사냥꾼 ‘딘 자린’ & 치명적인 귀여움의 ‘그로구.en: ‘Din Djarin’, the bounty hunter roaming the galaxy & ‘Grogu’, the deadly cutie

무자비한 적의 등장으로 인해 뜻밖의 동반자와 힘을 합치는 '슈퍼걸'의 이.en: An action blockbuster depicting the story of 'Supergirl' joining forces with an unexpected partner due to the appearance of a ruthless enemy.

결혼 후 연기를 안 하게 되었고, 이혼 후 다시 일을 하기 위해 독립영화.en: She stopped acting after marriage, and after her divorce, she shot an independent film to return to work. Today, she is giving an interview for the release of that movie. Now middle-aged, it is the day she is showing her face to the world as an actress for the first time in a very long while. Three interviews follow at thirty-minute intervals, and the woman does her best to answer the questions. After the interviews, she goes to her new acting class. There, the acting teacher asks her to reenact the interview from today. However, when she reaches the most crucial part of the interview, for some reason, she seems to have absolutely no memory of it. She is tired and wants to go home quickly. Her daughter is waiting.

미친 듯이 사랑했던 그레이스와 잭슨에게 아기가 생긴다. 불처럼 타오르던.en: Grace and Jackson, who loved each other madly, have a baby. Their love, which once burned like fire, slowly fades away, and even their sex life dries up. Deepening her loneliness, Grace finds it impossible to write as an author and begins to destroy herself. Jackson, watching this complete collapse from the sidelines, is seized by the fear that this love might never be restored.

1930년대 미국, 죽음에서 깨어난 ‘브라이드’와 그녀를 사랑하게 된 ‘.en: 1930s America. Bride awakens from the dead, and Frankenstein falls in love with her. One day, they commit a horrific crime and embark on a perilous escape. Breaking all societal norms, Bride and Frankenstein's unconventional actions shake the entire nation, and their fate spirals out of control…

전직 특수 요원이 과거를 뒤로 하고 조용히 살려다 한 사건에 휘말리며 다.en: A hard-boiled action film about a former special agent who tries to leave his past behind and live a quiet life, only to get entangled in an incident and reawaken as a 'human weapon'.

\"목표는 핵심 인물 암살, 특기는 살인, 임무는 댄스 대회 챌린지?!”.en: "Goal: Assassination of a key figure, Specialty: Murder, Mission: A dance competition challenge?!" A killer, unprecedented dance action movie featuring five killers with special objectives.

2075년, 자연이 너무 위험해져 아이들은 돔 안에서 생활하고, 부모 없.en: In 2075, nature has become so dangerous that children live inside domes and are raised by robots without parents. One day, ten-year-old Iris discovers a light of hope when she meets Arco, a boy of the same age who claims to have come from the future of 2932 and can fly through the sky on a rainbow.

2004년 2월 14일, 하청노동자 박일수의 죽음은 한 인간의 죽음이자.en: On February 14, 2004, the death of subcontracted worker Park Il-soo was the death of a human being, as well as the death of the passionate democratic labor union movement. Now, more than twenty years after that day of defeated revolution, there are two people continuing the work of art, dreaming of the world he so earnestly longed for. Through poetry and song, they carry on the defeated revolution of the past, moving from labor to ecology, to women, and to every precarious corner of our lives. Two videos, overlapping sounds, past and present... within the gaps of fragmented records, they discover the form of a new revolution.

중학교 졸업이 얼마 남지 않은 날, ‘여울’은 소꿉친구 ‘호수’에게 갑작.en: With middle school graduation just around the corner, Yeoul was suddenly bombarded with a confession from her childhood friend, Hosu! Since she couldn't think of him as anything more than a friend, she flatly rejected him... but who would have thought she would run into him again in high school! Every time Yeoul sees Hosu, a corner of her heart feels uneasy. She is also annoyed that things can never go back to how they used to be. In the midst of this, Yeoul impulsively confesses to a senior on the basketball team, and their first love descends into even greater confusion...

좀비 아이돌 프랑슈슈의 만국박람회 무대로 인류를 위협하는 정체불명의 존재.en: An unidentified entity threatening humanity approaches the stage of the World's Fair featuring the zombie idol group Franchouchou, and the unprecedented Galaxy Festival begins.

전설적인 가수, 아벨은 이별로 무너진다. 그런 아벨 앞에 나타난 의문의.en: Legendary singer Abel is devastated by a breakup. Then, a mysterious woman named Annie appears before him. The real story begins behind the scenes!
